dct_description_sm: Extracted from the Statistics Canada. It contains the information gathered during the 2016 Census with respect to the population within a dissemination area and the breakdown of this population by language most commonly spoken at home. Statistics Canada has suppressed the profiles for certain areas due to very low population count. Suppressed areas will appear as NULL values in the attribute table.
dct_rights_sm: Please refer to "York Region Open Data Licence", searchable on this website.
dct_title_s: Profile of Language (Spoken at Home) by Dissemination Area, 2016 Census
